scripts.features: Brand new script unlock gamepass style & grab changer ( don't execute directly put what you want on the grab and style or just execute it it has ghetto Ninja and back slam )
scripts.script:
local player = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer
local server = player.Server

for _, name in ipairs({
    "HasFasterAttacks",
    "HasStrongerPunches",
    "HasX2ClanXP",
    "HasX2XP",
    "HasX2Kills"
}) do
    local obj = server:FindFirstChild(name)
    if obj and obj:IsA("BoolValue") then
        obj.Value = true
    end
end

if server:FindFirstChild("Style") then
    server.Style.Value = "Ghetto Ninja" -- e.g. "Tyson", "Strong", or "Ghetto Ninja" "Bat" and "Katana" Dosent work
end

if server:FindFirstChild("GrabType") then
    server.GrabType.Value = "Back Slam" -- e.g. "Neck Slam", "Back Slam", or "Back Snap"
end
